text: Registry is keyed by `_installed_submodules` in `tenant_module_settings` for `module_id='cms'`. - Use `_cmsRegisterSubModule($id)` and `_cmsUnregisterSubModule($id)` — both are tenant-aware. - **Never write directly to `storage/cms-installed-modules.json`** from tenant context. That file is the legacy global fallback used only when `moduleTenantSettingsTenantId()` returns null.
